permits.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
permits.notes: Free and issued immediately online (Mon–Fri). Needed before opening a business bank account, registering for payroll taxes, applying for most state/local licenses, and the ABC/liquor application. Form your legal entity first so the EIN is issued to the right name.

permits.name: ASCAP public performance license
permits.issuing_agency: American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP)
permits.notes: Not a government permit, but federal copyright law requires a blanket license to play music publicly (background music, DJs, live covers, TV with music). Annual fee is formula-based (occupancy, live vs recorded, days per week). Most venues also need BMI; SESAC and GMR cover smaller catalogs. Alternatively subscribe to a licensed commercial music service that includes performance rights.
permits.stall_risk: Operators forget this entirely and receive demand letters after opening; it is cheap to set up and takes under a week, so schedule it in the final two weeks.

permits.name: BMI public performance license
permits.notes: Companion to the ASCAP license; the two catalogs do not overlap, so venues playing a general mix of music need both. Fee is formula-based on occupancy and music use. Sign up online; the license is effective immediately.

permits.name: FDA Food Code / allergen labeling compliance (no federal permit)
permits.notes: Restaurants are exempt from FDA food facility registration, but if you package and sell food for off-premises consumption (jars, sauces, baked goods to retailers) you fall under FDA labeling rules and may need to register the facility. Confirm with your county health department whether a separate food processing permit applies.
